links.outcome: Readability of LLM-generated patient education content on coeliac disease and type 1 diabetes
links.effect: ChatGPT 4.0 offered the most readable content, but all three models struggled with overall readability; improvements in readability were needed to enhance accessibility.
links.quote: While ChatGPT 4.0 offered the most readable content, all models struggled with overall readability.

screen.reason: Evaluated the accuracy, comprehensiveness, readability, and consistency of LLMs answering FAQs about paediatric chronic conditions without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
